selection_rule: Seed 1995 was adopted a priori to reuse the pinned upstream baseline seed; no signal values, anomaly scores, or future model results were inspected.
robotic_arm_rule: All anomaly recordings test; normal recordings stratified by domain and operating condition, approximately 80/10/10 by recording with minimum one validation and two test recordings per stratum. Regime S maps every target normal recording to test.
brushless_motor_rule: Released test retained; released normal-train recordings split 90/10 train/validation within domain and operating condition. Regime S maps released target-train normals to test.
